title: Reference-only spatial extension beyond R64
scientific_question: Does the B14 dynamic prescribed-head Richards Reference begin to show decreasing adjacent-grid change beyond 2.5-cm vertical resolution, and is that trend sustained at 0.625 cm if R256 remains numerically qualified under unchanged policy?

workload.lower_boundary: fixed-domain prescribed pressure head during RISE/FALL; mode-2 equilibrium HOLD

primary_new.numerical_policy: unchanged C5A/C5C D13 integrated-water-depth Reference policy

secondary_new.rule: Attempt after R128 without any policy change. If R256 fails a frozen numerical gate, retain the failure as evidence and close C5D using R128 without retuning.

diagnostic_io.reason: Node text is not used by C5D metrics and would scale output volume with 128/256 nodes. Suppression changes diagnostic I/O only.

additional: log2 adjacent-error ratio as descriptive observed order where defined

diagnostic_adjudication.R128_PROGRESS: R64-R128 pooled bottom-flux RMSE is smaller than R32-R64 RMSE.
diagnostic_adjudication.R128_NO_PROGRESS: R64-R128 pooled bottom-flux RMSE is not smaller than R32-R64 RMSE.
diagnostic_adjudication.R256_TWO_STEP_PROGRESS: R256 qualifies and both R64-R128 < R32-R64 and R128-R256 < R64-R128.
diagnostic_adjudication.interpretation: One or two decreasing adjacent-grid differences are evidence of refinement progress, not proof of a continuum limit.

R256_optional.if_failure: persist exact failure and continue analysis without R256

next_logic.if_R128_and_R256_two_step_progress: Reference refinement is progressing through 0.625 cm. Only then may a matched fine-bottom-cell LARE comparison against the finest qualified Reference be preregistered.
next_logic.if_R128_progress_but_R256_blocked_or_non: Preserve partial progress; do not claim asymptotic convergence and do not open a new closure formulation.
next_logic.if_R128_not_progressing: Reference spatial authority remains unresolved. Diagnose Reference spatial behavior before further LARE closure work.
next_logic.no_outcome: C5D itself never authorizes application acceptance, production ROM or performance claims.

pre_execution_implementation_binding.reason: C5D is motivated by the C5C discovery of Reference spatial nonconvergence, but R128/R256 grids and adjudication are frozen before their response is generated.
pre_execution_implementation_binding.allowed_new_code: Reference geometry extension, node-output suppression, state-only Reference aggregation
pre_execution_implementation_binding.prohibited_new_code: LARE representation changes, closure changes, solver-policy relaxation, fitted extrapolation used as acceptance authority
